svg.desc: Four kinds of leakage with their measured effect on this project: a target leak (0.16 to 0.58), a temporal leak from export-time columns (0.12 to 0.99), a group leak from a random split (a small rise) and a preprocessing leak (negligible), each with its defence.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four kinds of leakage, measured on this project
